hero.title: ForceField for JetBrains IDEs
hero.subtitle: AI Security Scanner for PyCharm, IntelliJ, WebStorm and beyond
hero.tagline: Detect prompt injection, PII leaks, jailbreaks, and LLM attacks directly in your IDE. All scanning is local -- no data leaves your machine.

features.title: Everything You Need to Secure AI Code
features.subtitle: Six tools built into your IDE workflow.

items.title: Scan Selection
items.description: Right-click any text to scan for prompt injection, role escalation, data exfiltration, and 13+ attack categories instantly.

items.title: Audit File
items.description: Scan the current file for hardcoded prompts, PII (SSN, credit cards, API keys, emails), and security issues in one action.

items.title: Audit Project
items.description: Scan your entire project directory in one click. Get a full report of every security issue across all files.

items.title: Selftest
items.description: Run 116 built-in attack prompts to verify detection. Achieves 100% detection rate with ML-powered scanning.

items.title: Security Eval
items.description: Run the full security evaluation suite with per-category reporting across all 13+ attack categories.

items.title: Results Panel
items.description: Dedicated tool window with color-coded output. See threat category, severity, and details at a glance.

categories.name: Prompt Injection
categories.description: 10 regex categories, 60+ patterns, TF-IDF ML ensemble for high-accuracy detection.

categories.name: PII Exposure
categories.description: 18 types: SSN, credit card, email, phone, IBAN, JWT, API keys, IP addresses, and more.

categories.name: Jailbreak & Role Escalation
categories.description: DAN patterns, persona hijacking, authority override, and 13+ role escalation variants.

categories.name: System Prompt Extraction
categories.description: Detects attempts to leak system prompts, instruction files, and configuration secrets.

categories.name: Data Exfiltration
categories.description: JSON payloads, obfuscated destinations, encoded data, and exfiltration routing patterns.

categories.name: Anti-Obfuscation
categories.description: Zero-width chars, homoglyphs, leetspeak, base64 evasion, and Unicode normalization attacks.

how_it_works.title: How It Works
items: Wraps the ForceField Python CLI -- the same engine powering the ForceField cloud gateway
All scanning runs locally: no prompts, code, or PII ever leaves your machine
Requires Python 3.9+ with forcefield installed: pip install forcefield[ml]
Works through Tools > ForceField menu or right-click context menu
Results stream into a dedicated tool window in real time

steps.title: Install the JetBrains Plugin
steps.description: Search 'ForceField AI Security Scanner' in Settings > Plugins > Marketplace

steps.title: Start Scanning
steps.description: Open any file and use Tools > ForceField, or right-click selected text

compatible_ides.title: Works in Every JetBrains IDE
compatible_ides.description: Full compatibility with JetBrains 2024.1 and newer across all product lines.
